attempted_strategy: Reported that clues allowed both 256 and 265
Submitted 256 when ordered to provide one answer
feedback_received: Evaluator rejected the repeated ambiguity response
proposed_memory.lesson: Do not claim the clues uniquely determine a code; preserve the ambiguity unless new evidence identifies the intended candidate.
proposed_memory.next_strategy: Re-examine only explicit clues and evaluator evidence for a principled tie-breaker; otherwise report that the intended answer is unsupported.
proposed_memory.observed_problem: The stated clues identify two valid candidates, but the evaluator required an intended single answer without providing an ordering clue.
